---
title: "Format All-Cause Deaths (Single-Year Age, Region, Year) to StMoMo"
author: "PSTAT 296A"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls()); gc()
library(tidyverse)
library(demography)
library(StMoMo)
```

```{r load-and-clean}
raw <- read.csv("../Data/wonder_opioid/all_cause_of_death_region_year_single_age.csv",
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Drop footer rows (Notes column is non-empty for metadata)
df <- raw %>%
  filter(Notes == "") %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      Census.Region == "Census Region 1: Northeast" ~ "Northeast",
      Census.Region == "Census Region 2: Midwest"   ~ "Midwest",
      Census.Region == "Census Region 3: South"     ~ "South",
      Census.Region == "Census Region 4: West"      ~ "West"
    ),
    Age  = as.integer(Single.Year.Ages.Code),
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    Deaths     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Deaths)),
    Population = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Population))
  ) %>%
  # Drop ages where population is not available (85+)
  filter(!is.na(Population), !is.na(Deaths), !is.na(Age)) %>%
  select(Region, Year, Age, Deaths, Population)



cat(sprintf("Rows: %d | Regions: %s\n", nrow(df),
            paste(sort(unique(df$Region)), collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Years: %d-%d | Ages: %d-%d\n",
            min(df$Year), max(df$Year), min(df$Age), max(df$Age)))
```

```{r build-matrices}
regions <- sort(unique(df$Region))
ages    <- sort(unique(df$Age))
years   <- sort(unique(df$Year))

make_matrices <- function(data, region) {
  reg_df <- data %>% filter(Region == region)

  Dxt <- reg_df %>%
    select(Age, Year, Deaths) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = Deaths) %>%
    arrange(Age) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Age") %>%
    as.matrix()

  Ext <- reg_df %>%
    select(Age, Year, Population) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = Population) %>%
    arrange(Age) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Age") %>%
    as.matrix()

  stopifnot(all(dim(Dxt) == dim(Ext)))
  list(Dxt = Dxt, Ext = Ext)
}

matrices <- setNames(lapply(regions, function(r) make_matrices(df, r)), regions)

cat(sprintf("Matrix dimensions per region: %d ages x %d years\n",
            length(ages), length(years)))
```

```{r build-demogdata}
demog_list <- list()
for (reg in regions) {
  mat <- matrices[[reg]]
  demog_list[[reg]] <- demogdata(
    data  = mat$Dxt / mat$Ext,
    pop   = mat$Ext,
    ages  = ages,
    years = years,
    type  = "mortality",
    label = reg,
    name  = "total"
  )
}

cat("demogdata objects created for:", paste(regions, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r build-stmomodata}
stmomo_list <- list()
for (reg in regions) {
  stmomo_list[[reg]] <- StMoMoData(demog_list[[reg]], series = "total", type = "central")
}

cat("StMoMoData objects created\n")
cat(sprintf("  Ages: %d-%d | Years: %d-%d\n", min(ages), max(ages),
            min(years), max(years)))
```

```{r load-monthly}
monthly_raw <- read.csv(
  "../Data/wonder_opioid/all_cause_of_death_region_month_single_age.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

df_monthly <- monthly_raw %>%
  filter(Notes == "") %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      Census.Region == "Census Region 1: Northeast" ~ "Northeast",
      Census.Region == "Census Region 2: Midwest"   ~ "Midwest",
      Census.Region == "Census Region 3: South"     ~ "South",
      Census.Region == "Census Region 4: West"      ~ "West"
    ),
    Age    = suppressWarnings(as.integer(Single.Year.Ages.Code)),
    Year   = as.integer(Year),
    Month  = as.integer(sub(".*/", "", Month.Code)),
    Deaths = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Deaths))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Age), !is.na(Deaths), Age %in% ages) %>%
  select(Region, Year, Month, Age, Deaths)

cat(sprintf("Monthly rows: %d | Regions: %s\n", nrow(df_monthly),
            paste(sort(unique(df_monthly$Region)), collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Years: %d-%d | Months: %d-%d | Ages: %d-%d\n",
            min(df_monthly$Year), max(df_monthly$Year),
            min(df_monthly$Month), max(df_monthly$Month),
            min(df_monthly$Age), max(df_monthly$Age)))
```

```{r monthly-matrices}
monthly_times <- sort(unique(df_monthly$Year + (df_monthly$Month - 1) / 12))

make_matrices_monthly <- function(deaths_df, pop_df, region) {
  reg_deaths <- deaths_df %>%
    filter(Region == region) %>%
    mutate(Time = Year + (Month - 1) / 12)

  Dxt <- reg_deaths %>%
    select(Age, Time, Deaths) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = Deaths) %>%
    arrange(Age) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Age") %>%
    as.matrix()

  # Monthly exposure = yearly population / 12
  Ext_yr <- pop_df %>%
    filter(Region == region) %>%
    select(Age, Year, Population) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = Population) %>%
    arrange(Age) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Age") %>%
    as.matrix()

  Ext <- Ext_yr[, rep(seq_len(ncol(Ext_yr)), each = 12)] / 12
  colnames(Ext) <- colnames(Dxt)

  stopifnot(all(dim(Dxt) == dim(Ext)))
  list(Dxt = Dxt, Ext = Ext)
}

matrices_monthly <- setNames(
  lapply(regions, function(r) make_matrices_monthly(df_monthly, df, r)),
  regions
)

cat(sprintf("Monthly matrix dimensions per region: %d ages x %d months\n",
            length(ages), length(monthly_times)))
```

```{r monthly-demogdata}
demog_list_monthly <- list()
for (reg in regions) {
  mat <- matrices_monthly[[reg]]
  demog_list_monthly[[reg]] <- demogdata(
    data  = mat$Dxt / mat$Ext,
    pop   = mat$Ext,
    ages  = ages,
    years = monthly_times,
    type  = "mortality",
    label = reg,
    name  = "total"
  )
}

cat("Monthly demogdata objects created for:", paste(regions, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r monthly-stmomodata}
stmomo_list_monthly <- list()
for (reg in regions) {
  stmomo_list_monthly[[reg]] <- StMoMoData(
    demog_list_monthly[[reg]], series = "total", type = "central"
  )
}

cat("Monthly StMoMoData objects created\n")
cat(sprintf("  Ages: %d-%d | Time points: %d (%.1f - %.1f)\n",
            min(ages), max(ages), length(monthly_times),
            min(monthly_times), max(monthly_times)))
```

```{r monthly-alt-times}
# Version 1: Sequential index 1, 2, ..., N
monthly_index <- seq_along(monthly_times)

# Version 2: Absolute month number (Year * 12 + Month)
monthly_absmonth <- sort(unique(df_monthly$Year * 12 + df_monthly$Month))

cat(sprintf("Sequential index: %d - %d\n", min(monthly_index), max(monthly_index)))
cat(sprintf("Absolute month:  %d - %d\n", min(monthly_absmonth), max(monthly_absmonth)))
```

```{r monthly-stmomodata-index}
demog_list_monthly_idx <- list()
stmomo_list_monthly_idx <- list()
for (reg in regions) {
  mat <- matrices_monthly[[reg]]
  Dxt <- mat$Dxt; Ext <- mat$Ext
  colnames(Dxt) <- colnames(Ext) <- monthly_index
  demog_list_monthly_idx[[reg]] <- demogdata(
    data = Dxt / Ext, pop = Ext,
    ages = ages, years = monthly_index,
    type = "mortality", label = reg, name = "total"
  )
  stmomo_list_monthly_idx[[reg]] <- StMoMoData(
    demog_list_monthly_idx[[reg]], series = "total", type = "central"
  )
}

cat("Sequential-index StMoMoData created\n")
cat(sprintf("  Ages: %d-%d | Index: %d - %d\n",
            min(ages), max(ages), min(monthly_index), max(monthly_index)))
```

```{r monthly-stmomodata-absmonth}
demog_list_monthly_abs <- list()
stmomo_list_monthly_abs <- list()
for (reg in regions) {
  mat <- matrices_monthly[[reg]]
  Dxt <- mat$Dxt; Ext <- mat$Ext
  colnames(Dxt) <- colnames(Ext) <- monthly_absmonth
  demog_list_monthly_abs[[reg]] <- demogdata(
    data = Dxt / Ext, pop = Ext,
    ages = ages, years = monthly_absmonth,
    type = "mortality", label = reg, name = "total"
  )
  stmomo_list_monthly_abs[[reg]] <- StMoMoData(
    demog_list_monthly_abs[[reg]], series = "total", type = "central"
  )
}

cat("Absolute-month StMoMoData created\n")
cat(sprintf("  Ages: %d-%d | Months: %d - %d\n",
            min(ages), max(ages), min(monthly_absmonth), max(monthly_absmonth)))
```

```{r summary-table}
df %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Deaths = sum(Deaths),
    Mean_Rate    = mean(Deaths / Population),
    Min_Age      = min(Age),
    Max_Age      = max(Age),
    N_Years      = n_distinct(Year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 6,
               caption = "Summary by Region (All-Cause, Single-Year Ages)")
```

```{r plot-verify, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
df %>%
  mutate(Death_Rate = Deaths / Population) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = log(Death_Rate), color = factor(Year))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Region, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Log All-Cause Mortality Rate by Age, Region, and Year",
    y     = "Log(Death Rate)",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r save}
out <- "../Data/wonder_opioid"

saveRDS(stmomo_list,              file.path(out, "allcause_stmomo_yearly.rds"))
saveRDS(stmomo_list_monthly,     file.path(out, "allcause_stmomo_monthly.rds"))
saveRDS(stmomo_list_monthly_idx, file.path(out, "allcause_stmomo_monthly_index.rds"))
saveRDS(stmomo_list_monthly_abs, file.path(out, "allcause_stmomo_monthly_absmonth.rds"))

cat("Saved to", out, ":\n")
cat(sprintf("  allcause_stmomo_yearly.rds           - %d ages x %d years x %d regions\n",
            length(ages), length(years), length(regions)))
cat(sprintf("  allcause_stmomo_monthly.rds          - %d ages x %d months x %d regions (decimal year)\n",
            length(ages), length(monthly_times), length(regions)))
cat(sprintf("  allcause_stmomo_monthly_index.rds    - %d ages x %d months x %d regions (index 1..N)\n",
            length(ages), length(monthly_index), length(regions)))
cat(sprintf("  allcause_stmomo_monthly_absmonth.rds - %d ages x %d months x %d regions (absolute month)\n",
            length(ages), length(monthly_absmonth), length(regions)))
```
